articles.title: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: The Series B funding round, led by Octagon Partners valued the London-based company at more than $100 million.

articles.title: Gemini sells UK and European operations to stablecoin payments firm KAST for under $10 million
articles.snippet: The sale follows the Winklevoss-founded crypto exchange’s retreat from several overseas markets as it restructures its business.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
articles.snippet: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

articles.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

articles.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
articles.snippet: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.
